t: You're on Grosvenor Crescent, a street in Belgravia. In December 2017 it was ranked the most expensive residential street in the UK, with an average house price of nearly seventeen million pounds. Two sons of the Gordon-Lennox family were born here: Lord Esmé Gordon-Lennox, and Major Lord Bernard Gordon-Lennox, a British Army officer who was killed in the First World War. Samuel Ernest Palmer, the first Baron Palmer, lived here too. He was a businessman and a patron of music.
